L110: Artist(s) with most wins  | 【39†NewJeans】 (12)
L111: Song with highest score  | "【40†I Am】" by 【41†Ive】 (10,586)
L112: 【41†Ive】's (pictured) win for "【40†I Am】" had the highest score of 2023, with 10,586 points on the April 23 broadcast. They also achieved 【42†triple crowns】 with both this song and "【43†Baddie】".
L113: The 【44†Inkigayo】 Chart is a 【45†music program】 【46†record chart】 on 【47†Seoul Broadcasting System】 (SBS) that gives an award to the best-performing 【48†single】 of the week in South Korea.
L114: In 2023, the chart measured digital performance in domestic online music services (worth up to 5,500 points in its ranking methodology), social media via 【49†YouTube】 views (3,000 points), album sales (1,000 points), network on-air time (1,000 points), viewer votes in advance of the show (500 points), and real-time voting via the Superstar X 【50†mobile app】 (500 points).^{【51†[1]】}^{【52†[2]】}^{【53†[3]】} Songs that spend three weeks at number one are awarded a 【42†triple crown】 and are removed from the chart and ineligible to win again.
L115: From April 3, 2022, to April 2, 2023, actress 【54†Roh Jeong-eui】, actor 【55†Seo Bum-june】, and 【56†Tomorrow X Together】 member 【57†Choi Yeon-jun】 hosted the show together.^{【58†[4]】} The former two were replaced by 【59†Monsta X】 member 【60†Hyungwon】 and actress 【61†Kim Ji-eun】 starting with the April 9 broadcast.^{【62†[5]】} Three months later they were replaced by 【63†BoyNextDoor】 member Woonhak and actress 【64†Park Ji-hu】.^{【65†[6]】}
L116: In 2023, 25 singles reached number one on the chart, and 15 acts were awarded a first-place trophy for this feat. "【40†I Am】" by 【41†Ive】 had the highest score of the year, with 10,586 points on the April 23 broadcast.
L117: Nine songs collected trophies for three weeks and earned a triple crown: 【39†NewJeans】's "【66†Ditto】",^{【67†[7]】} "【68†OMG】"^{【69†[8]】} and "【70†Super Shy】",^{【71†[9]】} 【72†(G)I-dle】's "【73†Queencard】",^{【74†[10]】} Ive's "I Am"^{【75†[11]】} and "【43†Baddie】",^{【76†[12]】} 【77†Jisoo】's "【78†Flower】",^{【79†[13]】} 【80†Jungkook】's "【81†Seven】",^{【82†[14]】} and 【83†AKMU】's "【84†Love Lee】".^{【85†[15]】} NewJean's "Ditto" was the first single to top the chart in 2023.
L118: This was followed at number one by their single "OMG". Both singles along with "Super Shy" held the top spot on the chart for three weeks each, achieving triple crowns. The group had two more singles ranked atop the chart in 2023: "【86†Hype Boy】" and "【87†ETA】". The five singles spent a total of 12 weeks in the top spot making NewJeans the artist with the most weeks at number one in 2023.
L119: Girl group STAYC achieved their first ever Inkigayo award in 2023 with their single "【88†Teddy Bear】" on the February 26 broadcast.^{【89†[16]】} In April, "Flower" by 【90†Blackpink】's Jisoo ranked number one, becoming her first chart topper.^{【91†[17]】} BTS's Jungkook also had his first number one on the chart in 2023 with his single "Seven".^{【92†[18]】} Both singles ranked number one for three weeks and achieved triple crowns, the only such awards for solo acts in 2023.
L120: Besides NewJeans, four other acts achieved a top ranking for more than one single on the chart in 2023. Girl group Le Sserafim had two number-one singles, "【93†Unforgiven】" and "【94†Eve, Psyche & the Bluebeard's Wife】". Aespa also reached the top spot twice in 2023 with "【95†Spicy】" and "【96†Drama】", the latter of which achieved a triple crown. In addition to Aespa, boy group 【97†Seventeen】 also had two singles reach the top spot in 2023: "【98†Super】" and "【99†God of Music】".
L121: Ive had four number-one singles in 2023, achieved with "【100†Kitsch】", "I Am", "【101†Either Way】" and "Baddie". "I Am" and "Baddie" went on to rank number one for three straight weeks each and achieved triple crowns.
